run_fit_normalizers_cli: run the fit_normalizers CLI script with a config yaml to compute dataset mean and std
run_fit_norms_with_linref: run fit_norms with a config, output path, and linear reference file to fit normalizers
fit_normalizers_from_config: fit dataset normalizers from a config file and save them to a specified output path
create_element_references_for_normalizat: create element references from a linear reference file for use in fitting normalizers
save_normalizers_checkpoint: save fitted normalizers as a checkpoint file named normalizers.pt to the output directory
